title: Jerusalem's Destruction Symbolized

questions.question: What tool did God tell Ezekiel to take and use as a barber's razor to pass over his head and his beard?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:1 (ESV): "And you, O son of man, take a sharp sword. Use it as a barber's razor and pass it over your head and your beard."

questions.question: What was Ezekiel to use to divide the hair he had cut?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:1 (ESV): "Then take balances for weighing and divide the hair."

questions.question: What was Ezekiel to do with the first third of the hair when the days of the siege were completed?
options: Burn it in the fire in the midst of the city
questions.correctAnswer: Burn it in the fire in the midst of the city
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:2 (ESV): "A third part you shall burn in the fire in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are completed."

questions.question: What was Ezekiel to do with the second third of the hair?
options: Strike it with the sword all around the city
Tie it in the skirts of his robe
questions.correctAnswer: Strike it with the sword all around the city
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:2 (ESV): "And a third part you shall take and strike with the sword all around the city."

questions.question: What was Ezekiel to do with the last third of the hair?
options: Scatter it to the wind, and God would unsheathe the sword after them
Burn it with the first third
questions.correctAnswer: Scatter it to the wind, and God would unsheathe the sword after them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:2 (ESV): "And a third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will unsheathe the sword after them."

questions.question: What was Ezekiel to do with a small number of the hairs?
options: Take them and bind them in the skirts of his robe
questions.correctAnswer: Take them and bind them in the skirts of his robe
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:3 (ESV): "And you shall take from these a small number and bind them in the skirts of your robe."

questions.question: What was Ezekiel to do even with some of those hairs bound in his robe?
options: Cast them into the midst of the fire and burn them
questions.correctAnswer: Cast them into the midst of the fire and burn them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:4 (ESV): "And of these again you shall take some and cast them into the midst of the fire and burn them in the fire. From there a fire will come out into all the house of Israel."

questions.question: What reason does God give for bringing disaster on Jerusalem?
options: "She has rebelled against my rules by doing wickedness more than the nations,"
"She failed to pay her yearly tithe,"
questions.correctAnswer: "She has rebelled against my rules by doing wickedness more than the nations,"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:6 (ESV): "And she has rebelled against my rules by doing wickedness more than the nations... for they have rejected my rules and have not walked in my statutes."

questions.question: How does God say He will execute judgments in their midst?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:8 (ESV): "Therefore thus says the Lord God: Behold, I, even I, am against you. And I will execute judgments in your midst in the sight of the nations."

questions.question: Because of all Jerusalem's abominations, what shocking thing does God say will happen within her?
options: Fathers shall eat their sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers
Lions will roam the streets freely
The temple will sink into the earth
The sun will turn black for forty days
questions.correctAnswer: Fathers shall eat their sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:10 (ESV): "Therefore fathers shall eat their sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers. And I will execute judgments on you,"

questions.question: Because Jerusalem defiled the sanctuary with their detestable things and abominations, what does God promise to do?
options: "I will withdraw. My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity."
"I will cleanse it with foreign blood."
"I will make a new covenant immediately."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will withdraw. My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:11 (ESV): "Therefore, as I live, declares the Lord God, surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, therefore I will withdraw. My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity."

questions.question: How does the fate of the first third of hair exactly match God's explanation of the punishment?
options: "A third part of you shall die of pestilence and be consumed with famine in your midst;"
"A third part shall be taken captive smoothly;"
"A third part shall rebel and win;"
"A third part shall flee to Egypt;"
questions.correctAnswer: "A third part of you shall die of pestilence and be consumed with famine in your midst;"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:12 (ESV): "A third part of you shall die of pestilence and be consumed with famine in your midst; a third part shall fall by the sword all around you; and a third part I will scatter to all the winds..."

questions.question: When God has vented His wrath upon them and spent His anger upon them, what will they know?
options: "That I, the Lord, have spoken in my jealousy"
"That their gods are weaker than Babylon's gods"
"That Jeremiah was the only true king"
questions.correctAnswer: "That I, the Lord, have spoken in my jealousy"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:13 (ESV): "Thus shall my anger spend itself, and I will vent my fury upon them and satisfy myself. And they shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken in my jealousy, when I spend my fury upon them."

questions.question: "Moreover, I will make you a... and a reproach among the nations all around you and in the sight of all who pass by."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:14 (ESV): "Moreover, I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations all around you and in the sight of all who pass by."

questions.question: What evil arrows does God say He will send against them to destroy them?
options: The evil arrows of the Assyrians
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 5:16 (ESV): "When I send against you the evil arrows of famine, weapons of destruction, which I will send to destroy you..."

key_verse_text: "Therefore, as I live, declares the Lord God, surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, therefore I will withdraw. My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity."
